mission: Classify generated-index sourceHead through exact canonical Git object-ID admission before ordinary current-HEAD comparison, so malformed evidence becomes UNRESOLVED rather than ordinary STALE.
appliedContract: The sole provenance owner imports and consumes try_forever_generated_index_source_head_policy.py.
SourceHead admission occurs after strict JSON and alias-consistency admission and before ordinary source_head != current_head comparison.
None and exact empty sourceHead preserve the existing not-declared UNRESOLVED state.
Malformed or normalization-dependent identity becomes typed UNRESOLVED evidence; it is not trimmed, case-folded, normalized, coerced, or classified as ordinary STALE.
Timestamp, dirty-source, freshness, artifact-custody, repository-custody, report-path, phone/P0, and runtime ownership semantics remain separate.
No duplicate provenance owner was introduced.
